name: finyahoo
description: Read Yahoo Finance prices and fundamentals from the command line, powered by the finyahoo CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read Yahoo Finance prices and fundamentals
interface.longDescription: Fetch a symbol's OHLCV price history, its fundamentals plus live price snapshot (profile), or a live quote across many symbols from Yahoo Finance via the finyahoo CLI. Works for US stocks (AAPL), Korean tickers (005930.KS), and indices (^GSPC).
defaultPrompt: Get the price history for AAPL
